crossRefs.note: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I…
Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is…
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
“Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly…
But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me…
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

translations.web: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
translations.bsb: For He is not a man like me, that I can answer Him, that we can take each other to court.
translations.kjv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
translations.asv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, That we should come together in judgment.
